description: Count the calendar days between two dates and break the gap into weeks, months and years, with the weekdays and weekend days inside it. Use it for 'how many days until X', tenure, age of a record, notice periods in calendar days and countdowns. Use business_days_between instead to leave out weekends and federal holidays, and time_duration_between when clock times matter. Valid for years 2000 to 2100.

end_date.description: The second date; if it is before start_date the two are swapped as a calendar date in the form YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2026-11-02.

include_end_date.description: Whether the end date itself counts as a day, which adds one to the total. Default false.

start_date.description: The first date as a calendar date in the form YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2026-11-02.

name: days_between_dates

calculator_url.description: The TeamPredict calculator page that shows the same calculation, where a person can change the inputs.

inputs.description: The inputs as used, with defaults filled in.

results.description: The computed numbers. Unavailable numbers are null.

summary.description: One or two plain sentences with the headline numbers.

title: Days between two dates
